name: rsodre-skills
description: Personal agent skills library: software design principles and review, spec and agent workflow discipline, TypeScript/React/Next.js conventions, and dapp chain-layer rules.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs core, web and web3 together. Use when a project wants the whole library; otherwise install the individual plugins.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic engineering discipline: 27 software design principles, a multi-persona design review orchestrator, agent-facing documentation rules, and conventions for running coding agents in a shared repo.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: TypeScript web stack conventions: Biome/TypeScript/React/Tailwind 4 coding style, Next.js App Router structure and data flow, OKLCH colour palette design, and pnpm monorepo + publishable-package rules.

plugins.name: web3
plugins.description: Dapp chain-layer rules: the react-query carve-out, native bigint numerics, address/ABI registry, read/write hooks and transaction toasts — EVM (wagmi + viem) and Starknet (starknet.js v10 + Cartridge + Torii) kept strictly separate.
